subject: Post-demo follow-up: pricing asks & $/1M benchmarking
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: pricing asks & $/1M benchmarking

Emma — great to meet you and the Acme team on the demo earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can prepare a concise pricing benchmark and formal proposal: 

1) Expected volumes (monthly): please confirm a baseline and a 6–12 month ramp expectation. Rough ranges are fine (e.g., 100M -> 1B tokens).
2) Usage mix: what % of tokens will be embeddings vs. chat/completions vs. reranking?
3) Current monthly spend today and any incumbent vendor pricing you can share (OpenAI / Anthropic / other hosts).
4) Target unit economics: what is your internal target $/1M tokens to make this viable? If you have a budget range (e.g., $X–$Y per 1M) that helps.
5) Procurement constraints: do you need an enterprise SOW, PO, or vendor questionnaire answered before pricing conversations? Any required security docs (SOC2, DPA)?

Attached is a working pricing sheet and a short benchmarking note — we'll populate these with Redwood-to-host comparisons once we get the volume and mix details.

Suggested next step: 30-min slot tomorrow to run through numbers with Ben (AE) and Marissa (CS) — are you available 10:00–10:30am PT?

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]
[Attachment: benchmarking-anchors.pdf (pdf, 210KB)]

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: pricing asks & $/1M benchmarking

Thanks, Priyom — appreciated the demo. Answers below to help you model: 

- Baseline / ramp: First 3 months we expect ~120M tokens/mo, ramping to ~650M by month 6 and target steady state ~1.1B tokens/mo by month 12. We may seasonally spike ~20% Q4.
- Mix: estimated 70% chat/completions, 25% embeddings, 5% reranking/other. Embeddings are high-QPS but lower token length per call.
- Current spend: roughly $7.5k/mo today (trial-phase) with a mix of hosted API and an internal experimental host. We don't have a formal incumbent contract yet.
- Target unit economics: procurement is pushing for ~$3.00/1M as the upper bound for hosted; if you can show a path to ~$2.00/1M at scale (>=1B/mo) with equivalent quality SLA, that would be a strong fit.
- Competitor references: we've seen public numbers of ~ $6.00/1M for OpenAI, ~$5.25/1M for Anthropic on similar workloads (these are indicative). Please show how Redwood compares across hosted vs dedicated vs private options.
- Procurement asks: SOC 2 and DPA are required; we'll have a brief vendor security questionnaire. We'll also need a simple PoC SOW for a 60-day pilot.

We can do the 10:00am PT slot tomorrow — confirm and send calendar invite.

Emma Liu
Head of ML Platforms, Acme AI
[Sent from mobile]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: pricing asks & $/1M benchmarking

Thanks for the detail, Emma — super helpful. Quick, high-level benchmark and an initial commercial outline we can formalize in the attached sheet. High-level assumptions: 70% completion workload, 25% embeddings, request/response lengths consistent with your team call (median context ~600 tokens).

Redwood comparative anchors (hosted inference, blended $/1M):
- OpenAI (public reference): ~ $6.00 / 1M tokens (baseline)
- Anthropic (public reference): ~ $5.25 / 1M tokens
- Redwood Hosted (initial tier): $4.50 / 1M tokens — designed for early scale and trial PoC (no commitment).
- Redwood Committed (reserved/dedicated capacity, 6–12mo commit): $2.75 / 1M tokens at ~1B/mo utilization — includes burst capacity, improved tail latency SLA, and prefix/KV caching savings baked in.
- Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem licensing): list + variable infra ops; effective $/1M can drop to ~$1.80–$2.20 at 1B+/mo depending on customer-managed infra and quantization profile.

Notes / levers we used: quantization and compilation optimizations (5–20% token-cost savings for completion-heavy workloads), dynamic batching, and prefix caching (saves tokens for repeated contexts). We can also map your embeddings-heavy slices to specialized endpoints to further reduce cost per embedding call.

Given your target of ~$3.00/1M and desire to see $2.00/1M at scale, the most realistic paths are: 1) Redwood Committed at $2.75/1M when you hit ~1B/mo OR 2) Redwood Private with a sizing/infra plan showing $1.8–2.2/1M. We'll put exact breakpoints and sensitivity in the spreadsheet attached.

Next steps: 
- Ben: can you confirm standard PoC SOW template and a sample timeline?
- Marissa: we'll prep SOC2/DPA answers and the vendor questionnaire today; expect to send by EOD.
- Emma / Acme: confirm if you want the pilot on Hosted or Dedicated (recommended for predictable SLA).

I've attached an updated pricing sheet that models your ramp and shows blended $/1M under the different deployment modes. Let's meet 10:00–10:30am PT to walk through the model — I'll send a calendar invite once Emma confirms.

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
